G1 GN21 is beside GN20 at the pit lane west end (D024 arrow 021, its orange symbol on the master), not by Gate 2
G2 every generator the master places sends the driver to its orange symbol (within 1 m)
R1 every text stays inside three texts (<= 459 GSM units), all plain
R2 the order line is on every named unit
R3 every reference with a waste tank says the tank goes first
R4 S08 drops (WB02, WB19, WC27) are land side: enter from the Surfers (south) end, race direction
R5 seaside drops (WC50, WC60, WC62) come in at the Seaworld Dr roundabout end and drive south
R6 a drop nowhere near Main Beach Pde carries no Main Beach entry line (AA, P01)
R7 Full details carries the whole rule set (order, entry, park, stagger, D007 event-week facts)
R8 the drawer shows a Driver rules box for a named unit, none for a unit no rule touches
R9 park drops carry the wildlife and branches caution, in the text when it fits and always in Full details
R10 the order check reads the record (GN21 before GN20 recorded out of order; P01 vs P03; WC05 vs P05, P04)

L1 the load rule (morning: away from Kingston by 05:00, in order, no travel 07:00-09:00 or 16:00-18:00; a timed delivery follows its own leave-by) is in Full details and the drawer of a delivery still to come

L2 the general load check flags the 14 Sep plan as if still to come and untimed (WC05 tank 08:30 after 05:00 and in the 07:00-09:00 no-travel window; toilet 09:30 after 05:00; P01 same slot as P03; P04 same slot as the WC05 toilet; P05 clean)
L3 a waste tank loading after its toilet block is called out
L4 nothing to check on a unit already on site (no noise on finished work)
T1 the time given is an UNLOADED-BY time: every Full details of a delivery still to come says so; a delivered one does not (its record, not a plan)

T2 a delivery still to come with a time reads "on site by .., unloaded by .." (30 min to unload), and the check gives the latest Kingston departure (WB04 at 09:00, no load time: in before the 07:00-09:00 window and a morning run away by 05:00, so on site by 06:10)
T5 a load that would be on the road in a no-travel window is called out with the load-by time (load 07:30 for 09:00: leave Kingston by 05:00)
T7 one plan, one answer: a timed morning load that leaves after 05:00 is called out, even with time to unload (load 05:30 for 09:00)
T6 one plan meets every constraint: 30 min to unload, 70 min run, never on the road 07:00-09:00 or 16:00-18:00, and a morning run away from Kingston by 05:00

T3 a load that reaches site after its unloaded-by time is called out (WC05 07:00: tank 08:30 runs into the no-travel window, toilet 09:30 lands after 07:00, as if to come); one that makes it shows its unloading time (P05: 50 min)
T4 a delivered record keeps its own words (P03: "on site 07:00")
D1 every Full details of a delivery still to come carries the dispatch rule (no driver leaves without firm directions)
D2 a delivery with a verified location but no way in is held - in the text, the drawer and Full details (WB13 - GN04 has its way in since v7.84); the label says DIRECTIONS, not ready to send
D3 no drop-off yet: the driver is sent to the pit lane (the spot by P33; never named) - text (with P33 GPS and Navigate), driver sheet and Full details (PG01)
D4 (measure) still to come: ready to send vs not, and why; delivered units are not counted
D5 a drop-off placed at the branch (Edit) reaches the driver sheet as well as the text - it replaces the pit-lane fallback (T0085, in memory only)
D6 (measure) every reference on the driver sheet: exact drop-off (pin, master, placed) vs description (water barriers) vs report to the pit lane
C1 clocks are always valid, and a time on another day says which (Codex review)
C2 a delivery just after midnight plans back into the day before (WB04 unloaded by 00:20: on site by 23:50 the day before, leave Kingston by 22:40 the day before)
C3 a load the day before is compared on the calendar, not the clock (23:00 the day before for 09:00: on site 00:10, 530 min to unload)
H1 a delivered unit shows its record, not a plan: no Time or Loading row, no time/load checks, no TIME/LOAD/DISPATCH lines (P03)

V1 a position the map review left unverified does not count as a drop-off: LTC01 goes to the pit lane - its source still says not verified, and Navigate names the pit lane it goes to (Codex recheck: the tooltip matches the destination)
V2 one source label on every surface: P47 is "confirmed by the project manager" in the text, Navigate, the pin record and the driver sheet
W1 every water barrier has a drop-off from its description - the spot the master marks, or (WB01, WB05, WB06) looked up from the description; none goes to the pit lane
W2 "P33" is never shown to a driver for a pit-lane fallback (text, driver sheet, drawer, Full details, sign)

Z1 every location has its way in by area (the project manager, 2 Oct 2026; zones read off the master D001): the island by the pit lane; seaside from the north end; land side and over the bridge from the south end; Gate 1 by the Tedder Ave access point and Gate 2 by the GC Hwy underpass (D007)
Z2 only WB07 (Admiralty Dr) and WB13, WB18, WB20 (Turn 2 / Ferny Ave) still need a way in - the project manager gave the rest on 2 Oct (v7.84)
M1 the done tick has its own double beat on the master plan
M2 the explorer gets the finished list
R11 (measure) a delivery-details link gives way only where a v7.82 line needs the room (ORDER, ENTRY, HOLD, the pit-lane directions, the spot for a water barrier) (the link stays in Full details)
R12 no Due line lost against the live page
R13 (measure) three-text messages
